subject: Vector Summit — quick follow-up on inference needs
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Vector Summit — quick follow-up on inference needs

Hi Emily — great to meet you at Vector Summit yesterday! Thanks for the quick chat about Lumeno's vision for real-time inference on customer-facing search and recommendations. I wanted to recap what I took away and propose a next step: 

Recap (from our conversation)
- Current: Lumeno runs a two-stage pipeline (sparse retrieval + re-ranker) on CPU for production; P50 latency ~220ms, peak QPS ~130.
- Goal: Move re-ranker to a GPU-backed LLM to improve relevance and reduce tail latency, target P95 < 400ms.
- Constraints: Sensitive customer data, SOC2 + regional data residency in US-EAST for a large retail customer pilot.

Suggested next steps
1) Short technical sync (30 min) next week to review sample payloads and SLOs.
2) Share a lightweight cost/latency projection for a 3-node GPU Dedicated + fallback plan to hosted for burst.
3) Provide Redwood's SOC2 summary and a short on-boarding checklist for Private deployments.

I attached a one-page intro deck with relevant latency/cost examples from similar retail pilots. Are you available for a quick sync Tues/Wed 14–17 PT? If procurement needs to be looped immediately, happy to include them on the invite.

Thanks — enjoyed the discussion and excited to help you evaluate options.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
